evals.prompt: Make me a deck for Examplex, a fiat-first crypto casino in Brazil with no on-chain footprint we can find. It's going to their Head of CRM, who is Brazilian. I want to send it this week.
evals.expected_output: Proxy-mode deck in Portuguese (or a recorded language decision), casino vertical, peer set confirmed with the user, basis lines on data slides, Enrich as primary path, buyer review recorded, lint --final OK, PDF/HTML/PPTX delivered, nothing sent.

evals.prompt: We just finished the hidden VIP pack for OKX. Can you turn it into something short I can send their CMO and also a version I can post on LinkedIn?
evals.expected_output: Reuses the pack's numbers as claims (no new queries), exchange vertical, Advertise as primary path for a CMO, a private deck and a second public deck without the prospect's name, logo or own data, share message and LinkedIn post drafted.

evals.prompt: Quick pitch deck for an FX/CFD broker in Cyprus, compliance-heavy, I'm meeting their COO on Thursday. Make it urgent.
evals.expected_output: fx vertical (clients, not players), proxy mode on brokerages/exchanges stated plainly, urgency only from verified regulator or dated events or a data trend (or urgency_skipped), no invented commercial terms, formal tone, method slide present.
